name: TIMWELL
recent: Timberwell 于 11 月完成 1 拆 3 股票分拆的除权与登记，分拆后新股将于 11 月 24 日上市。执行董事 Wong Wai Foo 在 10 月至 11 月间多次通过直接交易增持及减持股份。公司 10 月原木产量已公布。
notable: 股东在 11 月 3 日特别股东大会上通过 1 拆 3 股票分拆及资本削减议案。
股票分拆的除权日为 11 月 20 日，登记日为 11 月 23 日，分拆后新股于 11 月 24 日上市。
执行董事 Wong Wai Foo 于 10 月 13 日及 11 月 12 日通过直接交易分别增持 247 万股及 390 万股，同时减持等量间接持股。
risks: 股票分拆将现有 89,050,677 股拆分为 267,152,031 股，涉及股本数目扩大。
执行董事在闭市期前表示有意进行交易，并在闭市期内进行了股份交易。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 2,619,000 马币，环比增长 127.3%，但同比减少 43.3%；净利为 359,000 马币，净利率 13.7%，较去年同期的净亏损转为盈利。

recent_en: Timberwell completed the ex-date and entitlement for its 1-for-3 share split in November, with subdivided shares to be listed on 24 November. Executive Director Wong Wai Foo carried out several acquisitions and disposals of shares via direct business transactions between October and November. The company also announced its October log production.
notable_en: Shareholders approved the 1-for-3 share split and capital reduction at the EGM on 3 November.
The share split ex-date is 20 November, entitlement date is 23 November, and the subdivided shares will be listed on 24 November.

Executive Director Wong Wai Foo acquired 2.47 million and 3.9 million shares via direct business transactions on 13 October and 12 November respectively, while disposing an equivalent number of indirect shares.
risks_en: The share split subdivides 89,050,677 existing shares into 267,152,031 shares, increasing the number of shares in issue.
The Executive Director indicated an intention to deal during the closed period and subsequently traded shares during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 2,619,000, up 127.3% QoQ but down 43.3% YoY; net income was MYR 359,000 with a net margin of 13.7%, turning profitable from a net loss a year earlier.
